description: This file defines an interface 'ThingsAggregatorConfig' that provides configuration settings for the 'Things Aggregation' component within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods to retrieve timeout and parallelism configurations, as well as an enum that specifies default values for these settings.

classes.name: ThingsAggregatorConfig
classes.description: An interface that declares configuration retrieval methods for the Things Aggregator.

classes.name: ThingsAggregatorConfig.ThingsAggregatorConfigValue
classes.description: An internal enum implementing KnownConfigValue, providing default configuration paths and values for the aggregator.

methods.name: getSingleRetrieveThingTimeout
methods.description: Returns the Duration that the ThingsAggregatorActor should wait for a single retrieve thing operation.

methods.name: getMaxParallelism
methods.description: Returns an integer indicating the maximum number of RetrieveThing commands that can be in flight simultaneously.
